Despite early diagnosis and nutrition intervention, 
there are still problems associated with the disorder.
Although IQ levels have been reported to be normal in 
these patients,16 many aﬀ ected individuals with speech

plain the poor outcomes in these individuals, including
fetal damage in utero through exposure to galactose via
maternal circulation, damage before nutrition interven-
tion, de novo galactose synthesis, and an overrestric-
